title: SETU Space Industry and Education Workshop: Erasmus+ Blended Intensive Programme (BIP)
location: SETU Kilkenny Road campus, Carlow, Ireland
eligibility: Students and academic staff; participants should contact their home university International Office for nomination procedures
funding: No participation fee for SETU students and Erasmus BIP grant holders; Erasmus+ mobility grants may be available through home universities
description: The programme provides students and academic staff with an opportunity to engage with experts from the space engineering and industry sectors, focusing on space mission planning, proposal development, and emerging opportunities in the space industry.

title: ESA CubeSat Hands-On Training Week
eligibility: University students enrolled for 2026-2027 in a Bachelor, Master or Doctoral degree in an Engineering or Scientific subject, meeting ESA Academy eligibility criteria
funding: ESA sponsorship covers accommodation and meals, plus up to 350 EUR for travel to and from Belgium for selected students
description: This Training Week is a great opportunity for university students to get hands-on experience with CubeSats and to apply theoretical knowledge obtained from classroom lectures.

title: ESA Human Space Physiology Training Course 2026
eligibility: University students enrolled for 2026-2027 in a Bachelor or Master degree with a background in medicine, allied healthcare, life sciences, biomedical sciences or biological sciences, meeting ESA Academy eligibility criteria
funding: ESA sponsorship covers accommodation and meals, plus up to 350 EUR for travel to Belgium for selected students
description: The Human Space Physiology Training Course provides university students with a comprehensive introduction to the physiological challenges of human spaceflight.
